tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Default slide background; every text colour below reads on it in both themes.

tokens.name: paper-deep
tokens.usage: Second ground tone for alternating slides and quiet bands. Text: ink, ink-soft, ink-faint, synthetic. Teal text is not for this ground at small sizes.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Panels and table bodies set on paper. Text: ink, ink-soft, ink-faint, genuine, synthetic.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, panel outlines and all strong text on paper, paper-deep and paper-raised. Also the Step up outline and glyph, and the dark table header.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body copy on paper, paper-deep and paper-raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Captions, sources and footer text on paper, paper-deep and paper-raised. Minimum 24px on slides.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rules and dividers. Reaches 3:1 against paper, so it may carry meaning. Never used for text.

tokens.name: genuine
tokens.usage: Teal. Means a real voice, a verified step or the safe path. Text on paper and paper-raised; fill for chips, bars and nodes.

tokens.name: genuine-tint
tokens.usage: Panel fill behind genuine content. Text on it: ink or genuine.

tokens.name: synthetic
tokens.usage: Magenta. Means a cloned or synthetic voice, an alert, or the escalation path. Text on paper, paper-deep and paper-raised; fill for chips, bars and nodes.

tokens.name: synthetic-tint
tokens.usage: Panel fill behind synthetic or alert content. Text on it: ink or synthetic.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs set on a solid genuine or synthetic fill. Reaches 4.5:1 on both accents in both themes.

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: Cover title only, one per deck.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: The one heading at the top of each slide, in ink.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: One-sentence statement under a title or inside a statement slide.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text and table cells, in ink-soft.
styles.sample: The agent sees a plain message and one next step.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Sources, footers and notes, in ink-faint. Never below 24px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chip text, diagram node labels and stamps. Sentence case.

styles.name: hand-note
styles.usage: At most two per slide, eight words each, beside a hand mark.

styles.name: wordmark-hi
styles.usage: The Hindi wordmark on the cover and nowhere else.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between rows of a list or table.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding on small panels; footer row height.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Footer offset from the bottom edge.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Slide margin on a 1920 by 1080 canvas.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Panels, blocks and tables. The default.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, stamps, and 8px-wide bars that read as pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Large call-outs and phone-style frames in diagrams.
